Good evening! Here is your recap of what we accomplished today.

First, regarding work, you reviewed your schedule for the day, which included standup, an architecture sync, and a demo rehearsal this afternoon. We also worked on preparing for that demo; I made sure to add notes detailing the need to show both the new export button and the error state. Given your late-night sleep struggles, we set up a reminder for 9:00 PM tonight to start winding down.

In addition to wellness checks, you were looking into meal ideas! After an initial search for a vegetarian recipe with sweet potato and black beans didn't pull up a good result, I suggested roasting the sweet potatoes and serving them over rice with warm black beans.

Finally, we handled several small tasks today: I reminded you about the weather in Canberra, and when you needed to prepare dinner, I set a reminder for 3:20 PM for your rehearsal. Getting those important sleep routines dialed in seems to be a running theme lately, so I was happy to help with any tips or reminders you needed!
